product_one_liner.value: Authenticate® provides identity-verification, fraud-prevention, and background-screening tools—including APIs and SDKs—for businesses that need to verify customers or users during onboarding and ongoing monitoring.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its identity verification platform and related identity, background, and continuous-monitoring checks.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage has a Pricing navigation link and publishes prices for multiple checks and services.

named_customers.notes: The article identifies all three as clients/users of Authenticate.com.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 13 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies Park City, Utah, United States, as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists 2018 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows primarily product announcements and explanatory/marketing articles; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Authenticate has a public developer documentation portal with guides, API reference, and multiple topics such as webhooks, JWTs, and results analysis.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers board says there are no job openings at the moment.

model_provider.notes: I checked the public developer documentation, blog, security/compliance material, and privacy page; none of the available material publicly names an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The compliance page names SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS. Other legal or regulatory frameworks on the page are omitted because the requested list is limited to these five.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn describes Authenticate as unfunded and says it has not raised any funding rounds; no date or amount applies.

raised_18mo.notes: The company is listed as unfunded with no funding rounds, so it did not raise in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers board reports no current job openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index does not show a product or major-feature launch in the six months before 2026-11-09. Its dated product-launch post for ReAuthenticate is from 2024; the more recent visible material is informational blog content, not a launch announcement.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I could not verify a sufficiently complete current team roster or a dated C-level/VP join or departure within the window.
